summary: Adversarially audited implementation plan uncovering 7 concrete mistakes and spec/code contradictions (including why the previous agent's 'projection-verified' Earth put satellites on top of the globe, why Live acted like Replay, the FRONTEND_SPEC single-screen vs Simplified/Advanced contradiction, the dark-only spec lock vs Light/Dark mode, and the THRUSTER_OUT heartbeat blind spot), with clean separation of Live, Replay, Landing, Simplified/Advanced views, and Two-View 3D orbital rendering.
